prompts.featured: Use case: stylized-concept. Original MEE editorial illustration. Tactile ceramic, cut paper, glass and porous limestone; ivory #F7F6F2, cobalt #1547BB, vermilion #EF383E. Gallery-quality studio lighting, material grain, clear composition and realistic shadows. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, flags, watermarks or identifiable people. Conceptual illustration, not documentary evidence or a real chart. Wide cover 1200:630. A heavy ivory statistical yearbook lies open on a cobalt desk. Its pages contain faint embossed empty table cells but no letters or figures; several blank pages stand apart under a vermilion ribbon. A closed red folder and clear glass sphere nearby. Metaphor for gaps in available information, not a reproduction of an actual Cuban publication.
